material.title: Print shop spends two hours a day retyping quote details
material.bodyOriginal: We process 35 quotes a day. Our office retypes customer details from emails into an order spreadsheet and then into production tickets, taking two hours daily. We already pay for shop management software but cannot export the custom fields. What integration options have other shops used?
